summary: Refined the Skills settings UI so registry skills group strictly by their on-disk directories (matt-pocock-skills → engineering/in-progress/misc/productivity; pstack as a single flat group with no inner collapsibles), with personal skills consolidated under one collapsible. Verified via svelte-check, the agent-server test suite, and a live WebSocket round-trip after restarting the dev server, then committed as a62cde8.
decisions: Registry grouping is derived from the actual skill file path (`extensions/<package>/skills/<dir>/.../SKILL.md`); the final directory containing `SKILL.md` is treated as the skill row and excluded from collapsibles.
Personal skills are collapsed into a single 'Personal skills' group when all members are editable, instead of being grouped per directory.
Directory labels are computed from the package's source path; the `directoryLabel` helper no longer takes a `skills` parameter.
Committed all changes on branch `pi-web` as a single commit `a62cde8` titled 'refine agent resource settings'.
errors: A direct WebSocket probe to `ws://localhost:8787` returned HTTP 400; root cause was that the dev server's WebSocket endpoint lives at path `/agent` (configured in `apps/agent-server/src/transport/websocket-server.ts` with `path: options.path ?? '/agent'`), so the request without that path was rejected. Retrying against `ws://localhost:8787/agent` succeeded.
